correctness.rationale: Exactly 3b+3 interval parameters, and the unit group consists of invertible diagonals and 2b+1 arbitrary strict entries. All three commutation equations are derived directly from incidence convolution. Splitting on equality of the two outer diagonal pairs gives an invertible linear central equation for the unequal case, and a nondegenerate alternating pairing condition for equal pairs. Both strata are counted with exhaustive binomial summation, and dividing the commuting-pair count by the exact group order yields the displayed formula. The argument is characteristic-free and the packaged executable independently checks ten instances. Boundary b=1 is explicitly identified as classical.

value.rationale: The group of units is a natural invariant of a finite incidence algebra and its conjugacy-class number is the number of complex irreducible characters. The family is the first nonabelian-radical step beyond the bipartite/height-two incidence monoids treated in directly relevant prior work. The uniform all-field, all-b closed formula is a meaningful natural infinite-family enumeration, and the explicit (q−1)^(b+1) difference isolates how nonzero composition of incidence intervals changes representation-theoretic class counts; it is not an arbitrary low-dimensional special case.
